researchScope: Mazda3 01/2019 onward factory workshop manual d9n1-1a-22d_ver10, published by Mazda and publicly mirrored at CHARM. Exact engine, transmission and module chapters retained. No manufacturer-specific P1 namespaces used.
limitations: Generic catalog entries are illustrated by exact Mazda monitor applications, not universal repair instructions.
Unresolved catalog-definition differences and source-table contradictions retain useful supported prose but are explicitly needs-review.
No live vehicle, repair, price, repair outcome or physical safety claim is asserted.
Source calibration values are limited to the exact documented engine/module; no market/model-year expansion is inferred from the manual folder.
